I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is Thea Ramaswell.

- **Where it came from:** Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift.
- **Also seen:** Thea was the customer contact in #inc-qfl-sev1 last November, when duplicate inbound trailers came up again at the Superior terminal. Marcus is in that channel.
- **Not known:** I can't see any Quarrendon account files, so I couldn't confirm Thea's title or contact details. I suggested he ask Dana.

My summary for Dana's question was also posted in #north-team as its own message. It says she told me something in private but doesn't say what, and it shouldn't have gone into the channel. You might want to delete it.
